requestedDirection: AI-generated Minecraft/SAO illustrations with coherent artist-like finish; not claimed to be human-authored

prompts.aincrad:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: 16:9 wide website hero illustration, 2048 x 1152.
Primary request: An art-directed, artist-like illustrated Minecraft environment inspired by Aincrad from Sword Art Online. A believable floating medieval fortress above a sea of clouds, seen from a shaded block-built stone terrace. Make a beautiful restrained game key art painting, not a photorealistic AI fantasy panorama.
Composition: left 38% is quiet dark foreground stone and a single tree canopy with low visual contrast, suitable for website text. The recognizable castle silhouette is in the right half. One broad stone bridge with consistent rails leads diagonally from lower right into one clear entrance. The fortress has THREE legible stepped tiers, ONE central keep and FOUR modest square towers, all grounded on one solid floating landmass. No additional floating castles. Horizon at upper third; generous calm sky. Everything shares one rigorous perspective and one Minecraft block scale.
Style: deliberate hand-painted gouache-like game concept illustration over clean Minecraft voxel geometry; visible controlled brush shapes, crisp chosen edges and softer distant edges, broad simple value groups. Individual cubic blocks and stepped shapes remain readable. Clean restrained design, intentional material transitions, no random surface detail. The kind of cohesive composition a skilled environment illustrator would finish.
Palette and light: midnight petrol foreground, muted blue-grey stone, moss green, ivory cloud shapes, a few small warm amber lanterns. Clear late afternoon light from upper right. Avoid oversaturated cyan and glossy metal.
Constraints: no people, no creatures, no symbols, no banners with logos, no text, no UI, no watermark. Architecture must be buildable in Minecraft: straight beams, consistent modular masonry, stairs attached to platforms, bridge connected at both ends, doors aligned with floors. No ornamental spaghetti, melting geometry, impossible overlapping towers, repeated glowing specks, texture noise, elaborate filigree, automatic-looking generic epic fantasy polish. Prioritize a clean silhouette, calm areas and structural clarity.
prompts.forest:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide 16:9 environment illustration for a Minecraft / Sword Art Online website bestiary banner.
Input image 1: STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Make a completely new scene, not a modification of the castle. Match its deliberate block-built forms, restrained illustrated lighting and matte stone.
Primary request: A calm, beautifully composed Aincrad forest ruin built from Minecraft blocks. Three tall square-trunk oak trees frame an old stone path, a small clear stream and ONE modest ruined stone gateway. The path leads through that gateway into a pale misty forest clearing on the right. Moss sits on ledges and joins, not random all-over detail. A few cubic foliage clusters create readable layered silhouettes.
Style: carefully finished game environment illustration with controlled gouache-like brush planes over rigorous voxel construction. Clear block shapes, thoughtful edge hierarchy, coherent one-point perspective. A believable Minecraft build with every slab, stair and column physically connected. Elegant, quiet, human-art-directed composition.
Framing: panoramic, subject gateway and stream on right half; left third dark calm foliage for page text. No isolated floating chunks. No castle towers, no creatures, no people.
Light/palette: blue-grey shaded masonry, muted forest greens, soft ivory daylight at the clearing, subtle warm amber from ONE lantern fixed to the gateway. Soft matte materials, generous simple value groups.
Constraints: no logos, emblems, letters, text, interface or watermark. No glossy fantasy rendering, neon cyan, generic particle haze, tangled branches, fractal ornament, noisy repetitive leaves, melted stones or conflicting block scales. Do not fill every area with detail.
prompts.guild:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide 16:9 environment illustration for a Minecraft / Sword Art Online website guild page.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: carry over clean modular voxel masonry, painterly matte planes and the restrained blue-grey / warm amber palette. Create an entirely new interior.
Primary request: A welcoming, carefully built Minecraft guild meeting hall in Aincrad. Human-art-directed game key art, quiet, coherent, not a cavernous generic fantasy cathedral. A modest rectangular hall with a clearly constructed oak-beam ceiling, six square stone piers, one straight upper gallery with regular supported railings, a few plain deep navy cloth banners, and two simple oak trestle tables at the sides. A broad central aisle leads toward a small raised oak meeting table by tall RECTANGULAR windows in the back right. No throne.
Composition: panoramic with gentle single-point perspective. Leave left third darker and calm for website copy. Put the lit windows and meeting table in right half, readable in a shallow banner crop. No crowded props, chairs need simple consistent legs connected to their seats.
Lighting: late afternoon ivory light from right windows, FOUR visible amber lanterns in structurally plausible wall brackets. Soft shadows, matte wood and stone, warm lived-in atmosphere without clutter.
Style: deliberate hand-painted environment illustration over Minecraft block geometry, controlled brushwork, chosen crisp edges, simpler distant detail. Stone courses at one consistent block scale; straight wooden beams resting on pillars; square lanterns; clean stair-step transitions.
Constraints: no characters, people, creatures, logos, heraldry, text, watermark or UI. Blank banners only, no Nameless monogram. No chandelier forests, giant arch nests, twisted rails, glowing runes, melted furniture, random scaffolding, flickering specks, excessive candles, CGI bloom, glossy amber saturation or extreme fine-detail texture. Every structural element must make sense.
prompts.workshop:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide 16:9 environment illustration for the item catalogue banner of a Minecraft / Sword Art Online website.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match clean voxel construction, matte painted surfaces, restrained blue-grey stone and amber light. Create a new scene.
Primary request: A small, beautifully designed Minecraft artisan workshop in Aincrad. A coherent room made of modular grey masonry and oak beams. THREE clearly recognizable functional stations only: a stout oak workbench at middle right, a simple cuboid stone furnace with a square amber opening on far right, and an iron anvil on a timber stump between them. One closed chest underneath the workbench. A high rectangular window admits cool daylight. A plain navy cloth hangs on the left wall, without markings.
Composition: wide view at natural eye level with one consistent perspective. The left 40% is quiet shadowed stone for text. Workbench, anvil and furnace sit on the right half, clean silhouettes readable in a shallow website banner. Calm restrained room rather than a treasure shop. Solid floor plane with consistent rectangular paving, beams align with supports. No stacks of props and no weapons hanging everywhere.
Style: artist-like finished game environment illustration, controlled gouache-like planes over Minecraft cubes, thoughtful clean edges, little fine texture, simple readable construction and matte materials. Clearly belongs to the same art set as input.
Lighting: restrained amber glow from furnace and ONE cuboid lantern placed securely on the bench, blue-grey natural fill from the window. No fire sparks or luminous dust. Metal is cool matte grey, no golden sheen.
Constraints: no text, logo, emblem, character, creature, UI or watermark. No decorative crystals, cauldrons, fantasy runes, random loot, bent beams, melted tools, inconsistent cubic scale, glossy CGI, oversaturated orange, overly complicated trinkets, detail noise or ambiguous geometry. Keep the anvil unmistakably an anvil, the bench four sturdy straight legs, the chest closed with one simple central latch.
